description: 5th connection of this batch, still read-only. 4th connection found TOBi's own full docs installed at /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/docs/ (not mirrored into this repo's work/design/refs/) plus `makei init`/`makei cvtsrcpf` subcommands this batch never used. This connection reads the specific docs that should explain the correct project layout/Rules.mk syntax/init workflow, plus the bundled sample project's own Rules.mk, to replace guessing with the tool's own documentation before attempting another build.

steps.label: TOBIDOCS
steps.cmd:
echo ---IPROJ-JSON-MD---
cat /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/docs/prepare-the-project/iproj-json.md </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---RULES-MK-MD---
cat /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/docs/prepare-the-project/rules.mk.md </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---CREATE-NEW-PROJECT-MD---
cat /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/docs/prepare-the-project/create-a-new-project.md </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---CONVERT-SOURCE-CODE-MD---
cat /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/docs/prepare-the-project/convert-source-code.md </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---SAMPLE-BUILD-MD---
cat /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/docs/getting-started/sample-build.md </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---SAMPLE-PROJECT-TREE---
find /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/tests/data/build_env/sample_project1 </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---SAMPLE-PROJECT-RULESMK---
cat /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/tests/data/build_env/sample_project1/Rules.mk </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---SAMPLE-PROJECT-IPROJJSON---
find /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/tests/data/build_env/sample_project1 -iname 'iproj.json' </dev/null 2>&1 | while read -r f; do echo "--$f--"; cat "$f" </dev/null 2>&1; done
